crossRefs.note: “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head…
Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations…
Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept…

translations.web: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.
translations.bsb: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
translations.kjv: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
translations.asv: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
